title: Emulating Public Opinion: A Proof-of-Concept of AI-Generated Synthetic Survey Responses for the Chilean Case

bias_targets.methodology: Meta-regression analysis of F1-scores comparing LLM-generated synthetic survey responses to human probabilistic sample responses across different age groups (18-29, 30-44, 45-59, and 60+).
Meta-regression analysis of F1-scores comparing LLM-generated synthetic survey responses to human probabilistic sample responses between female and male respondents.
Meta-regression analysis of F1-scores comparing LLM-generated synthetic survey responses to human probabilistic sample responses across urban and rural areas.
